Class GuardrailEngineAutoConfiguration

java.lang.Object
com.gridynamics.forge.guardrail.config.GuardrailEngineAutoConfiguration
@AutoConfiguration @AutoConfigureAfter({SemanticAutoConfiguration.class,GuardrailAutoConfiguration.class}) public class GuardrailEngineAutoConfiguration extends Object
Creates GuardrailEngine after semantic beans when semantic mode is active, so the pipeline includes SEMANTIC instead of logging a false "missing" warning.
